title: Summer Time Rendering: The Goodbye on the Beach
alt: A beach at sunset. The sun is half down in the sea under great rose and gold clouds, and a broad path of its light lies on the water. At the edge of the water a girl stands with her back to us, with very long fair hair that streams to the left in the wind. The side of her that is toward the sun is coming apart into small pieces of gold light, which rise and drift away over the sea. A boy with black hair stands nearer to us at the left, also with his back to us, and looks toward her. Their long shadows come toward us over the wet sand. At the left is a dark hill with two tops and small lights at its foot.
summary: A painting of the goodbye on the beach from Summer Time Rendering in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the end of Summer Time Rendering, the manga by Yasuki Tanaka. Shinpei comes home to the island of Hitogashima for a funeral, and lives the same summer days again and again to save the people there. Ushio is with him through all of it.
When it is over, she cannot stay. She goes into light at the edge of the sea, at sunset, and he lets her go. We see their backs. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
